summary: This study tests how well a hybrid closed-loop insulin delivery system controls blood sugar in people with type 2 diabetes around the time of surgery. These patients are receiving parenteral nutrition, which means they are getting liquid nutrition directly into their veins. The trial plans to enroll 40 participants and is currently Recruiting. The sponsor is the Second Xiangya Hospital of Central South University.
